title: Audio Tags for Universal Translator
tagline: Adds audio tags to the universal translator prompt
description: Pretty much does what it says on the tin - a small edit to render your audio tags instructions into the universal translator prompt. It doesn't matter which audio tags prompt you use, this just copies it in to make it available for the universal translator.
author: oldcustard
changelog: 1.1.0: Rebased on the SkyrimNet 0.30 base universal translator (prompt-cache layout, spoken language and subtitle translation, multi-line preservation). Audio tags now pass render_mode as a template argument and also apply in translation-only mode; tags stay out of <translation> blocks.
